tips.text: Vanquish every Sister you hunt for Tenet weapons anyway; a Dorma-headed Hound turns up in the pre-built ones.
Join other players' Sister showdowns; every squad member who vanquishes gets a blueprint roll.
Throw the Xoris in the Granum Void, then heavy attack mid-air to detonate it; it one-shots Errant Specters.
Expect the odd vanquish with no component blueprint; the drop is not quite guaranteed.
Check the Model before selling an unclaimed Hound for 20,000 credits.
Keep your only Dorma Model blueprint for the Hound you will gild; built components cannot be recovered.
Run Conservation solo on normal difficulty for the standing.
Donate spare Hounds to Legs for Solaris standing, more when gilded, to pay for the gild.
Nobody farms Dorma on its own; it arrives as a side effect of Sister hunts for Tenet weapons.
Players name the Sister cycle and the gild-and-relevel step as the painful parts.
